findings.name: Normal PR and branch push events
findings.detail: Branch-only push excludes tags. Ordinary pull_request tests the event merge integration SHA; checkout explicitly uses github.sha, and checks require actual HEAD equality on hosted runs.

findings.name: Token and checkout boundary
findings.detail: Only contents: read; no job permission override, secrets context, release-write job, pull_request_target, workflow_run, self-hosted runner, release/tag trigger or unsafe checkout opt-out. Checkout removes credentials before running tests.

findings.name: Action execution pins
findings.detail: Official action repo refs resolve to the recorded full commits; releases and verified commit metadata agree, action.yml uses node24. The tags/releases are mutable; full commit references determine executed action bytes.

findings.name: Verified CI-only dependencies
findings.detail: Exact versioned HTTPS GitHub release archives, archive size and SHA256 verified before extraction, ZIP paths/types/duplicates/case collisions/file ancestors and expansion/path limits checked before extraction, fresh CreateNew file extraction and complete ordinal member inventory verified. FFmpeg version, libmp3lame/aac/libvorbis/libopus encoders and MP3 decoder queried explicitly.

findings.name: Owned download and evidence scope
findings.detail: Fresh AFP-CI-GUID direct TEMP/RUNNER_TEMP child, recorded exclusive owner marker/token, no reparse ancestors, evidence directly in approved parent with CreateNew. Five-minute cancellation and elapsed guard plus 30-second body read wait, bounded pinned byte count, all network/file streams disposed. No global module installation, persistent PATH/policy change, production downloader or binaries in Git.

findings.name: Dependency execution binding
findings.detail: Checks compare setup/lock fingerprints, owner token/marker, exact selected member paths and actual complete 45-file FFmpeg/53-file analyzer inventories to checked-in lock before executable use or Import-Module; actual module version/base checked after import.

findings.name: Tests and reports
findings.detail: Actual supported-shell parsing, pinned analyzer default Error diagnostics plus selected correctness/security diagnostics, pure runtime/policy contracts, retained real-FFmpeg isolated baseline and sequential last native tests. Child task/shell/commit/source/exit/status/case gates checked; real media requires owned cleanup and native suite requires synthetic/descendant release proof.

findings.name: Artifact boundary
findings.detail: Upload is restricted to current run/shell T17 JSON evidence, no hidden files, default overwrite false, unique shell/run/attempt name, 14-day retention. Failure upload is diagnostic evidence, not release assets or trusted input to a privileged follow-up.

findings.name: Release gate
findings.detail: No automatic publication path exists. RELEASE_RUNBOOK Gate 2 requires explicit owner authorization for exact source C and ZIP/manifest SHA256; later tag/draft operations use reviewed assets and --verify-tag. T17 does not create a release, tag or public asset.

primary_sources.supports: Full action SHA pins, least privilege and avoiding untrusted secret-bearing execution.
Ordinary PR workflow/checkout merge integration consistency; privileged PR trigger risks.
Branch-only push filters exclude tag events; Windows powershell and pwsh shell semantics.
PR event SHA is merge integration commit, distinct from feature-head metadata.
Pinned checkout v7 credential removal and node24 runner minimum 2.327.1.
Auth removal in finally when persist-credentials is false.
Pinned artifact action runtime and default overwrite/hidden-file false.
FFmpeg publishes source and links external gyan.dev Windows builds.
Official analyzer release and source commit provenance.
ResponseHeadersRead timeout covers headers; body reads require separate bounds.
Hosted windows-2025 is Windows Server; actual image/runtime version must be recorded per run.

limitations: This is an audit of the reviewed workflow and scripts, not a claim that a malicious PR cannot alter its own checker. Read-only token permissions and absence of secrets/privileged execution are the security boundary.
Publisher byte hashes and GitHub verified commits establish the reviewed provenance/pins; they do not independently authenticate vendor binaries or prove every transitive action dependency bug-free.
The restricted YAML subset is deliberately for this one workflow and fails closed on unsupported syntax. It is not a general YAML implementation.

Hosted Windows Server CI is supplementary to active-machine Windows 11 acceptance. No hosted green run, manual console/phone playback, frozen ZIP or release verification is asserted by this source audit.

The complete T16 milestone suite remains retained; routine CI selects focused pure contracts, isolated retained baseline and native process coverage. Dependency ZIP guard tests are also committed and locally checked.
Local dependency roots intentionally remain available for subsequent checks until independently verified owned cleanup; setup does not delete arbitrary trees.
No repository visibility/protection/Actions settings, credentials, main merge, tag or release mutation was performed by this audit.
